subject: Planned model version shift: v2g -> v3 — timelines, comms, and exception process
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:02:00Z
Subject: Planned model version shift: v2g -> v3 — initial timeline and asks

Team —

We have finalized the high-level plan to transition the hosted API default from model v2g to v3. v3 brings improved context handling and cost-per-token reductions, but it has incompatible tokenization on a small subset of prompts; we need a coordinated migration and comms plan before flipping defaults.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- 2026-11-15: Public deprecation notice (60-day notice) + published migration guide
- 2026-11-22: SDK patch (compat shim) released to NPM/PyPI
- 2026-12-01: Beta compatibility mode enabled for 6 weeks
- 2027-01-31: v2g legacy endpoint retired for hosted customers (dedicated/private handled separately)

Immediate asks:
1) Sales (Laura, Karthik): identify active deals / prospects that must be notified now — flag any where v2g is contractually guaranteed or where migration work should be part of commercial terms. Please send a list by EOD 2026-10-19.
2) CS (Marissa): draft a migration playbook (step-by-step, rollback guidance, sample prompts) and a tech-runbook for customers needing hand-holding. Attachments welcome.
3) Engineering/SDK (Hannah, Stephanie): confirm feasibility of a compatibility shim with token-preserving mode and estimate dev + QA effort (weeks).
4) Legal/Finance (cc'd via Laura if relevant): advise if we need contract addenda or credits for migration effort for specific deals.

I've attached the initial migration-checklist.xlsx for you to annotate. Please reply with exceptions (enterprise customers that must be put on an exception path) no later than 2026-10-26. If we need to extend the runway for specific customers, include clear justification and expected migration date.

I'll schedule a 45-minute sync for next week to walk the plan and agree on comms templates.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: migration-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T18:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Planned model version shift: v2g -> v3 — initial timeline and asks

Aditya —

Quick clarifying questions from Sales:
- Will Dedicated customers (reserved capacity) get the same public retirement date, or will we offer a longer exception window? We have two large commitments (Nimbus Analytics, AltoStack) that are mid-contract and report v2g-specific tuning.
- For prospects in late-stage deals, will migration effort be eligible for implementation credits/discounts? If so, what's the policy so I can model into current renewals?

I ran a quick pass on active deals and attached a short matrix. Top-of-mind items:
- Nimbus Analytics (DEAL-4871): deep prompt engineering on v2g; will need a migration engagement. Primary contact: Priya Shah <priya@nimbus-analytics.com>.
- AltoStack: procurement legal asked about rollback guarantees — they want the old endpoint kept for 3 months post-retirement for testing.

I can gather more detail but need input on the exception policy and whether CS/Eng will provide migration hours as part of contract credits.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prospect-impact-matrix.csv (text/csv)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T20:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Planned model version shift: v2g -> v3 — initial timeline and asks

Thanks Aditya — tagging in a few notes from the revenue side.

Summary of impact I see right now (quick bullet):
- High-priority: Nimbus Analytics (enterprise; implementation team engaged). We should offer a combined CS+Eng migration block; they will likely push for an exception until they finish re-tuning.
- Medium: AltoStack (procurement will elevate without rollback guarantees).
- Several SMBs on pay-as-you-go will be OK with the SDK patch and the compatibility mode.

My ask: allow a small controlled exception window for large enterprise customers (up to end of Q2 2027) if they submit a formal migration plan and purchase a migration bundle (T&Cs to be worked out). This avoids churn while giving us visibility and a commercial path.

I'll own outreach to the named accounts and coordinate commercial language with Laura. Also can run a short comms template to customers so they understand timelines and what action we expect.

I agree we should meet — please set a time. I'll be in PDT mornings next week.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T22:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Planned model version shift: v2g -> v3 — initial timeline and asks

Aditya —

From a CS/programs perspective, a few technical risks customers will hit and what we need to mitigate:
- KV cache invalidation: any customers storing cached prefixes will see token offsets shift; we need a recommended invalidation pattern and sample scripts.
- SDK breakage: if tokenization differs, the best UX is an opt-in compatibility flag in SDKs that performs v2g tokenization and a server-side translation for the interim. This is not free — estimate ~2w eng + 1w QA for the SDK teams to implement and push.
- Monitoring: we need per-customer regression detection (prompt-level diffs) — can we add a quick evaluation harness keyed to customer prompt sets?

I'll start a CS migration playbook draft and attach the first cut. If Sales can provide prioritized account lists, CS will schedule migration clinics.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: cs-migration-playbook.md (text/markdown)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:11:00Z
Subject: Re: Planned model version shift: v2g -> v3 — actions and confirmed decisions

Thanks everyone for fast responses — here's a concise decision record and next steps so we have clarity.

Decisions (confirmed):
- Public notice goes live 2026-11-15. We'll publish: timeline, migration guide, SDK compatibility flag, and CS engagement options.
- Compatibility shim: Eng (Hannah, Stephanie) will scope a compatibility flag prototype and give a firm estimate by 2026-10-19. Target: SDK release 2026-11-22.
- Exceptions: Dedicated/reserved customers and enterprise accounts may request exception windows. Exception requests must be submitted by 2026-10-26 with a migration plan. Exception approvals require sign-off from Sales + CS + Product.
- Commercial aid: Sales can offer a one-time migration credit; Finance/legal will be looped per-deal.
- Monitoring: Research/Applied ML will help build a prompt-diff harness; CS will provide sample prompts for top accounts.

Action items assigned:
- Sales (Laura, Karthik): provide prioritized account list and suggested exception candidates by 2026-10-19.
- CS (Marissa): finalize playbook draft by 2026-10-21; schedule migration clinics starting 2026-11-01.
- Eng (Hannah, Stephanie): compatibility shim estimate by 2026-10-19.
- Product (Aditya): publish draft comms and migration guide 2026-11-01; finalize public notice 2026-11-12.

I created a calendar invite for a 45-minute cross-functional sync on 2026-10-15 at 17:00 UTC. Please accept if you can. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=transition-sync-20261015

If there are urgent objections to the timeline, raise them here by EOD 2026-10-14.

Aditya
[Related doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-model-transition-plan]
